glossary.definition: As used in this section "down payment" means that part of the payment of the cash price required by the retail seller as a condition to the delivery of the specific goods sold or to be sold or to the extension of credit to the retail buyer for any portion of the cash price.
glossary.source_title: Section 1317.04 - Separate items to be listed in written instrument.
